  column user_id | bigint | NULL |  |  |

  column role | text | NOT NULL |  |  |
  column created_by | bigint | NULL |  |  |
  column created_at | timestamp with time zone | NOT NULL | now() |  |
  column expires_at | timestamp with time zone | NOT NULL |  |  |
  constraint invitations_check | CHECK (((kind = 'reset'::text) = (user_id IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint invitations_created_by_fkey | FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint invitations_kind_check | CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['new'::text, 'reset'::text])))

  constraint invitations_role_check | CHECK ((role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'viewer'::text])))

  constraint invitations_user_id_fkey | FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  index CREATE INDEX invitations_expires_idx ON public.invitations USING btree (expires_at)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX invitations_new_name_idx ON public.invitations USING btree (lower(username)) WHERE ((kind = 'new'::text) AND (username <> ''::text))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX invitations_pkey ON public.invitations USING btree (id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX invitations_reset_user_idx ON public.invitations USING btree (user_id) WHERE (kind = 'reset'::text)

  column created_at | timestamp with time zone | NOT NULL | now() |  |
  column last_login_at | timestamp with time zone | NULL |  |  |
  column prefs | jsonb | NOT NULL | '{}'::jsonb |  |
  constraint users_pkey | PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint users_role_check | CHECK ((role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'viewer'::text])))
  constraint users_username_check | CHECK ((username ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._@-]{3,64}$'::text))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_external_idx ON public.users USING btree (auth_source, external_subject) WHERE (external_subject IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_pkey ON public.users USING btree (id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_username_idx ON public.users USING btree (lower(username))
table webauthn_ceremonies
  column id | text | NOT NULL |  |  |
  column user_id | bigint | NULL |  |  |
  column kind | text | NOT NULL |  |  |
  column data | jsonb | NOT NULL |  |  |
  column expires_at | timestamp with time zone | NOT NULL |  |  |
  constraint webauthn_ceremonies_pkey | PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint webauthn_ceremonies_user_id_fkey | FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX webauthn_ceremonies_pkey ON public.webauthn_ceremonies USING btree (id)
table webauthn_credentials
  column credential_id | bytea | NOT NULL |  |  |
  column user_id | bigint | NOT NULL |  |  |
  column name | text | NOT NULL |  |  |
  column public_key | bytea | NOT NULL |  |  |
  column attestation_type | text | NOT NULL | ''::text |  |
  column aaguid | bytea | NOT NULL | '\x'::bytea |  |
  column sign_count | bigint | NOT NULL | 0 |  |
  column transports | text[] | NOT NULL | '{}'::text[] |  |
  column backup_eligible | boolean | NOT NULL | false |  |
  column backup_state | boolean | NOT NULL | false |  |
  column user_verified | boolean | NOT NULL | false |  |
  column created_at | timestamp with time zone | NOT NULL | now() |  |
  column last_used_at | timestamp with time zone | NULL |  |  |
  constraint webauthn_credentials_pkey | PRIMARY KEY (credential_id)
  constraint webauthn_credentials_user_id_fkey | FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  index CREATE INDEX webauthn_credentials_user_idx ON public.webauthn_credentials USING btree (user_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX webauthn_credentials_pkey ON public.webauthn_credentials USING btree (credential_id)
function
  CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.drop_share_partitions(p_share bigint)
   RETURNS void
   LANGUAGE plpgsql
  AS $function$
  DECLARE t text;
  BEGIN
      FOREACH t IN ARRAY ARRAY['dirs', 'files', 'dir_category_agg', 'share_ext_agg'] LOOP
          EXECUTE format('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS %I', t || '_s' || p_share);
      END LOOP;
  END $function$
function
  CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ensure_share_partitions(p_share bigint)
   RETURNS void
   LANGUAGE plpgsql
  AS $function$
  DECLARE t text;
  BEGIN
      FOREACH t IN ARRAY ARRAY['dirs', 'files', 'dir_category_agg', 'share_ext_agg'] LOOP
          EXECUTE format('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS %I PARTITION OF %I FOR VALUES IN (%s)',
                         t || '_s' || p_share, t, p_share);
      END LOOP;
  END $function$
